title: Technical Architect .NET
description:
Job purpose: 
 Design & implement the best-engineered technical solutions using the latest technologies and tools. 
 Who You Are: 
 Define, design, develop and support the architecture of products/projects. Formulate and communicate technical vision and strategy to business and technical stakeholders. Create and improve software using the design patterns, refactoring and development best practices. Design software systems & products with various Microsoft technologies and ensure compliance to all architecture requirements. Guide a team of Engineers in design and code. Ability to understand non-functional requirements such as scalability, security, application monitoring, performance, etc. Prior experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Good experience with Test Driven Development. Well versed in agile methodologies and vendor engagement model. Design architecture for various different components and validate tools. Establish architectural methodology of all deliverables. Hands-on experience in database like mysql, mssql, mongodb etc. Build and deliver complex technical solutions. Participate in Project planning and Estimation. Prepare the architectural document artefacts. Lead technical project teams & give trainings to technical teams. Provide technical expertise during the presales and estimation process. Provide detailed & accurate estimates for code development efforts. Conduct code, design and architectural reviews. 
 What will excite us: 
 Experience with Visual Studio, C#, ASP.NET, MVC, .NET, Netcore, WCF, WPF, and Unit Testing Frameworks Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure or GCP Experience using UML modeling and diagramming tools like Enterprise Architect, MS Visio Experience in responsive User Interface Development for the web desktop and mobile devices Experience with database performance troubleshooting for Oracle and/or SQL Server is desired Exposure to performance and scalability improvement is desired Excellent written and oral communication/presentation skills Out of the box thinking and creative problem-solving skills 
 What will excite you: 
 Opportunity to work on large scale enterprise solution building. Opportunity to explore new technologies & frameworks with accomplished solution architects & industry leaders. Will get exposure to latest aspects of security, AI/ML, Business Domain and data analytics. 
 Work Location: 
 Ahmedabad (WFO)

Key Skills: High level design,Technical architecture,LLD,Level Design,Architecture,.Net,Rabbitmq,Technical

title: Software Architect
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a highly experienced  Software Architect  with strong expertise in  API architecture ,  frontend frameworks (React and Angular) , and backend technologies, including  .NET and Node.js . The role requires hands-on architectural leadership and the ability to prepare  Scope of Work (SOW)  documents, effort estimations, and detailed technical solution designs, while collaborating with  US-based stakeholders . Experience with  cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)  and  DevOps practices  is required. 
 Key Responsibilities Design and lead scalable application architectures Define API-first architecture using REST/GraphQL and microservices principles Architect and guide frontend solutions using React and Angular Design and oversee backend systems using .NET and/or Node.js Provide architectural guidance for  AWS/Azure-based deployments Drive  DevOps practices , CI/CD pipelines, and release automation Prepare detailed Scope of Work (SOW), including:
 Functional and non-functional requirements Architecture diagrams and technology stack definitions Effort estimation, timelines, and milestones Assumptions, dependencies, and risk assessments Participate in pre-sales activities and client technical discussions (UK time zone) Guide engineering teams and conduct architecture and code reviews Ensure best practices in security, scalability, performance, and maintainability Required Experience & Skills 10+ years of overall software development experience Proven experience as a Software / Technical Architect Strong hands-on experience with .NET and Node.js Strong experience in React and Angular frontend architecture Strong database expertise in SQL, MySQL, and PostgreSQL Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms Strong understanding of DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines Solid understanding of microservices and API design Experience preparing SOWs, estimations, and technical documentation Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
